summary: First Mining Gold Corp., a Vancouver-based gold developer listed in the US via Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of an interim report on Form 10-Q/8-K), furnished its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, with CEO and CFO certifications. No transaction terms, securities, or corporate action are disclosed; the filing is a routine quarterly reporting package incorporated by reference into its Form F-10 shelf. Cash was C$78.1M, total assets C$427.7M, and a C$135.1M silver stream derivative liability marked a fair value loss. No deal terms; nothing actionable for risk-arb.
